I have farmed this land since I was a boy and my father showed me how to make yam mounds. Chemical fertilizer in a bag is too expensive for this small plot near my house, so I will use goat manure that I have saved instead. I will plant my own yam setts from last harvest, not new seeds from the market, and my wife and I will clear the weeds with our cutlasses when they grow. We do not spray chemicals or use a water pump — we wait for the rain — and we will not hire workers because this small plot is just for our family to manage.
